title: News and Instructions for Safar
body:
Dastoor yaa RijaalAllah, madad. As-salaamu `alaykum. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la
ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alaa Sayyidi 'lAwwaleen wa ’l-`khireen, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), wa `alaa aalihi wa saahbihi wa man tabi`ahum biihsaan ila yawm ad-deen. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh, yaa `ibaadAllah. Always try to say, "as-salaamu
`alaykum" as that brings safety for you and for all people. Now people have forgotten to say, "as-salaamu
`alaykum." The Seal of Prophets (s) said, ad-deenu nasihah, "Religion is advice." Religion was brought from
Heavens through prophets, to bring people to the right path and to make them clean ones, because Allah
Almighty likes that His servants are clean ones; they are going to Paradise, and dirty people are going to the
Fire.
O People! Now we are coming closer to to the Last Day, Yawm al-Qiyamah. It is a period of this world when
people who were living on this planet will be called for judgment on Judgment Day, then Allah Almighty is
going to ask His servants what they did with their lives on this planet. Allah Almighty sent 124,000 warners

or prophets to remind people, and to make them understand what their missions are here on this planet.
Everything has been sent to people in every era, and the first warner and prophet, or the first messenger for
Mankind, was the first man, our grandfather, Sayyidina Adam (a). From his time up to the time of the Last
Messenger, the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) sealed that he
is the last one for all nations! He is the Last One to make people know their positions and learn how they
should deal with their Creator, the Lord of Heavens, Almighty Allah Ta`ala. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and
sits)
But now, I am sorry to say, the number of Mankind just reached five billion people, more or less, and the
majority of Mankind is just living on this planet and saying, "We know so many things that our ancestors did
not know or did not reach such knowledge." They think that to learn about technology is something that gives
them honor! To make such things does not give honor to you when you leave this life and when we are going
to be called, "Come, O Mankind! Come for your judgment in the Divinely Presence, to the One Who brought
you when you were nothing, and now you are saying, 'We are something!'" You claim you are something, but
after a while you are going to be dust, nothing! Your souls are the only "something" that have been granted to
you from Heavens! Our physical beings are never working, and never doing anything with their physical
beings alone, just as a car (that runs well) but can't move if they do not put petrol in it. When the petrol
finishes, new-fashion 2011 car models are now coming and people await them in showrooms, but they can't
move (on their own). To take you from one place to another, you must put something in them to make them
run, just as without souls our physical beings can't move. When the period of our souls reaches to the last
point, then that man falls down and dies.
Now Mankind claims they know everything, but you do not know that point because people say, "If we cannot
see it or touch it, we do not accept it exists!" That is their wrong decision and understanding. Now we are
running towards the time in which the Lord of Heavens is going to call everyone to judgment on the Last Day,
and the people in our days are drunk, never interested in such things. As they have become uninterested in
spirituality or heavenly news, some Signs will begin to be sent to them to make them think on it to
understand. Now people reached the top point of technology, but so many strange happenings are coming in
our days. People on Earth become like ants when the skies are covering them and sending something. They
run away, but to where are they running? That technology and their knowledge can't bring any solution to

save them!
Now Europe is under heavy winter conditions and its people are running way, but to where are they running?
They have never thought there is Someone's `iraada, will, sending those heavy clouds with millions of tons of
snow and ice. How have millions of tons of snow been carried from one side to another? Elsewhere, massive
flooding can't be stopped. They do not know where it is coming from and to where it is going, yet Mankind
prefers to be drunk on New Year's Eve! What is that? They are running after that, but not thinking about
what is happening all around themselves and now whole continents are witnessing and experiencing heavy
rains that cause floods. That is carrying everything and the heedless people can't stop it! Now Australia has
heavy rains during their summertime (we are now in winter), and they never thought such floods would come
and carry everything away in summer, because people are drunk.
O People! You must try to think, ask, learn, and understand how these happenings are appearing on this
planet. But people, governments, officials, and men and women are drunk, and the animal world also knows
nothing about what they are going to do.
O People! Come and listen from Prophet's heavenly news! Come and try to understand how to do your best,
for yourself and for all of nature and living ones; if not, it will finish. We are asking forgiveness this month,
Safar, the heaviest month in the twelve months of the year, and it is well known that it is the heaviest,
carrying so many heavy happenings. Therefore, we have been ordered to make at least two raka`ats sajdah
for our Lord and to ask forgiveness, even two raka`ats, and to say 300 times "astaghfirullah."
O our Lord! We are asking for Your forgiveness! Forgive us so that cursing may be lifted! If not, an order is
coming that in the near future there will always be much more difficulty.
O People! Come and ask forgiveness and put your foreheads in front of the Divinely Presence for saving you
here and Hereafter. Say three times, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan
`abduhu wa rasooluh, and say astaghfirullah 300 times daily, give charity daily, even one piaster or one mille
or less. Give for yourself and for your children, and run to make your charity for everyone; that charity is
saving people here and Hereafter. We are weak servants, trying to reach east and west on this planet to save
people from bad futures and cursing! May Allah forgive us.

O People! Ask for more mercy from Allah Almighty, to put you under His divinely protection, for the honor of
the Seal of Prophets (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa
surooran, sultaanan wa ridhwaana. Bi hurmati 'l-Fatihah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
(Baya`)
